decisions: Use physical evidence to repair the R24 sustained-contact fragmentation, pickup duration and missed first/second observations, not metrics alone. Select only from trials with their entrypoints pinned before independent results. Use all disclosed independent R24 and R23 conditions as development data, not as validation after selection. Require old R24 true-slot floors +5 ms latency and +5 active samples, no new false, duplicate, quiet-prefix, tool or tail failures on the old panels. Require an actual positive repair and no loss of a physically separate second. Where archived panels lack event duration, remeasure it on the relevant cohort. A strictly beneficial component that passes all exposed protections may be selected alone. Prefer the eligible composition with most distinct evidenced repairs; break ties by more gained strict slots, then lower alarm cost, then fewer new physical models. If none qualifies keep R24; do not run the R25 blind as if a failed development trial were qualified. No post-blind switching or scientific promotion.
